root_cause: The existing innovation benchmark checked only presence of six metrics. Negative runtime/cost, non-finite values, out-of-range false-positive/reproducibility rates and a non-verified incumbent security baseline could all produce decision ADOPT through ordinary JS numeric comparisons.

observed_evidence.synthetic_repro: incumbent defect_yield=0.2 runtime=100 cost=10 false_positive_rate=0.2 reproducibility=0.95 security_fit=true; candidate defect_yield=0.3 runtime=-200 cost=-1 false_positive_rate=-1 reproducibility=2 security_fit=true; old comparator returned ADOPT

failed_approaches: Interpret presence of a metric as comparable valid numeric evidence
Interpret negative cost/runtime as excellent improvement
Allow missing verification of incumbent security baseline
Treat ADOPT as provider or production release authority
fix: Validate both benchmark records using finite nonnegative numeric values, false-positive/reproducibility ratios in [0,1] and genuine Boolean security evidence. Reject candidate security regression. Withhold comparison when baseline security is unapproved. Preserve original defect-yield/false-positive/runtime/cost/reproducibility comparison for valid metrics; make every result explicitly advisory with promotion_authorized=false.
prevention_rule: No autonomous technology/model adoption from invalid, coerced, negative, out-of-domain, unverified or self-declared benchmark metrics. Quality comparison is advisory only. Before any promotion require independently collected baseline/cohort, appropriate sample size, shadow/canary, Required, CodeQL, Supabase/tenant/RLS, cost/permission approval and production outcome readback under the existing single-writer authority.

invariants: numeric metrics must be finite real numbers, not coerced strings
runtime and costs cannot be negative
false positive and reproducibility proportions must lie in [0,1]
incumbent security baseline must be true
valid realistic improvement remains an advisory only
no new scheduler, agent, queue, model spend or release bypass

terminal_rule: This fix is live only after exact-head Required+CodeQL and protected merge with main readback, canonical Brain skill projection and evidence of the existing Quality workflow using the validated comparator. An advisory ADOPT does not authorize a model upgrade or production deploy.
